description: GPT-4 family models accessed through OpenAI API for text generation

justification.D_rationale: D=1: User data sent to OpenAI servers. OpenAI data usage policies apply. Contractual controls available through enterprise agreements and API data policies.
justification.T_rationale: T=1: Model architecture and weights are proprietary. Only API-level behavior observation. OpenAI publishes model cards and system cards with limited detail.
justification.A_rationale: A=1: Model responds to API calls with predefined behavior. Does not autonomously plan or execute multi-step workflows (that is the consumer's responsibility).

edge_case_notes: When GPT-4 is used with function calling and code interpreter, the combined system may warrant Tier C classification depending on the autonomy of the orchestrating application.
